params.body:
## What was wrong

A partner keeps the id of a car after the dealer deleted it in Stocklist. When the same car returns to the partner's feed, the partner sends `PUT api/vehicles/{id}/update` for that old id. The car then never came in:

- for a partner that is not a premium trader, the call was refused as any update is ("update-method temporary unavailable", status 200) and what it carried was kept as a proposal on the deleted car, which nobody sees;
- for a premium partner, the lookup excludes deleted rows, so the answer was "no vehicle found" (500).

Neither case raised an error or a mail. Read on production on 16 November 2026: over the five days `api_log` keeps, one such call, from one garage, for a car deleted six weeks earlier. Rare, but silent.

## What changes

In `VehicleApiController::update`, before the premium check: when the id names a deleted car of the caller's own dealer, the call runs through `store()`, the same path as a create.

- The response is the detail of the new car, so the partner learns the new identifier.
- The old row is not restored and not written to. It was deleted on purpose and its data is from then.
- The body is judged as a create. `update` and `store` already share `VehicleRequest`, so this needed no new validation: a body that lacks what a create requires is refused with the names of the missing fields and creates nothing.
- When the car already stands live at the dealer, the duplicate check of the create path decides, as on a plain create. A partner that keeps sending the old id therefore does not create the car a second time.
- Another dealer's car, deleted or not, is answered as before (R P3-1.2), and so is an id that does not exist.
- When creating the car again fails, the catch of `store()` applies: the office mail goes out and the loss is counted with its cause (R P3-2.8, R P3-2.15). No new cause was needed: an update on a deleted car was not counted before, and after this change it is either a car that came in or an ordinary failed create.

The public API description of the update endpoint says in two lines what happens for a deleted vehicle.

## Known limit

Whether the partner takes over the new identifier from the response of an update is not known. If it keeps the old one, later updates for it answer "vehicle already found in system" and do not become proposals on the new car (the Car-Pass link still gets through, R P3-2.14). The car is in Stocklist either way.

## Rules

- New: R P3-2.16 (an update for a deleted car of the own dealer creates the car again).
- R P3-2.9 points to it.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/APartnerUpdateOnADeletedCarCreatesItAgainTest.php`, 8 tests: a regular and a premium partner, a partial body, another dealer's deleted car, a chassis number that stands live, a partner that keeps the old id, an update on a live car, and a failed create that is mailed and counted. Five of them fail without the change in the controller.

- Full suite: 3284 tests, 33228 assertions, green (2 skipped, 1 incomplete, as before).
- PHPStan: no errors.
- Pint on the added file: passed.
params.title: A partner's update for a deleted car creates the car again
